contexts.text: An iron rod () = the Truth which is of the Lord's Word.
A rod out of the stock of Jesse ().
The power of those who reason from scientifics against the truths of faith... is signified by the rod with which Asshur will smite... ().
A staff, and rod, () manifestly = power.
An iron rod () = the power of spiritual truth in natural...
The rod of His mouth, and the breath of His lips () = the Divine truth from which is Judgment.
The tree is man; the sprout or stalk with branches and leaves, are the means, and are called the truths of faith.

He shall rule them with an iron rod () = through truths from the sense of the letter, and at the same time through rational things from natural lumen... For by a rod, in the Word, is signified power... AE 176.
Who should pasture all nations with an iron rod () = (the same as above). AR 828.
The rod of His mouth = truth in ultimates, which is the truth of the sense of the letter. AE 727:7.
The rod of her branches () = the falsity of doctrine in which is evil.
An iron rod = the power of natural truth from spiritual; for by a rod is signified power, and it is predicated of Divine truth spiritual.
Rods of strength () = Divine truth as to power...
Pasture Thy people with Thy rod () = the instruction of those of the Church in Divine truths from the Word... The rod, here, = the Word, because it = Divine truth.
The rod of His fury () = the dominion of infernal falsity.
The signification of a rod. Further Illustrated. AE 727:19, et seq. AE 730:39.
